This indicates a potential pathway where Pralatrexate could influence the progression or manifestation of the disease through its interaction with Forodesine. The shared indication with Forodesine and the indirect relationship through the lymphoma subtype suggest a possible mechanistic link, though the exact nature of this relationship remains to be elucidated. The evidence is consistent across multiple paths, reinforcing the hypothesis that Pralatrexate may play a role in the development of this lymphoma through an indirect mechanism involving Forodesine.
